description: This file contains the PHP class 'Modification' which is part of the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Event' namespace. It defines a controller class that handles various types of operations (controller, model, view, library) related to modifications, including methods to resolve routes to appropriate files in the extension directories.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Controller class extending the system engine Controller, managing route resolution for extensions and modifications.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Resolves a route to a controller file within the extension directory, adjusting the route if the file exists.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Resolves a route to a model file within the extension directory, adjusting the route if the file exists.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Resolves a route to a view template file within the extension directory, adjusting the route if the file exists.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Resolves a route to a library file within the extension directory, adjusting the route if the file exists.
